description: A React component for displaying and managing a list of channels in the Mattermost admin console, including search, pagination, filtering, and navigation to channel details.

classes.name: ChannelList
classes.description: A React component class that renders a list of channels with search, filter, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes the component by loading the first page of channels.

methods.name: isSearching
methods.description: Determines if a search or filter is active based on the search term and filters.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates and returns pagination details such as start count, end count, and total number of channels.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of channels, either via search or default data fetch.

methods.name: searchChannels
methods.description: Performs a search for channels matching the search term and filters.

methods.name: searchChannelsDebounced
methods.description: Debounced version of searchChannels to limit API calls during rapid input.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of channels.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and triggers page reload with search term.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data grid displaying channels.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates the rows for the data grid based on current data, search, and filters.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Handles filter changes and reloads data accordingly.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the channel list component with data grid, search, and filters.
